chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from Hammad ibn Usman, from Al-Halabi, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)
That the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) dug out the chasm (lahad) for him, [and it was] Abu Talha Al-Ansari.

key_terms.أَبُو طَلْحَةَ: Abu Talha, a companion of the Prophet
key_terms.الْأَنْصَارِيُّ: The Ansari, referring to a member of the Ansar (helpers) of Medina
key_terms.لَحَدَ: To dig a chasm or niche in the side of a grave

ai.seo_question: Who dug the chasm for the Prophet Muhammad in his grave?
ai.summary: This hadith from Al-Kafi highlights the Prophet Muhammad’s (peace be upon him and his family) personal humility and simplicity in death, as he was buried in his dwelling in a simple grave with a single chasm (lahad) dug by his companion Abu Talha al-Ansari. This practice underscores the Shia emphasis on the Prophet’s modesty and serves as a primary model for Islamic burial rites, distinguishing the sepulchre from elaborate tombs. The narration reinforces the spiritual equality of the faithful, as the leader of the believers was interred in the same manner as his companions.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, form Hammad Bin Usman Al Halby, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> that
Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup>, the one who dug out the chasm for him<sup>saww</sup> was Abu Talha Al-Ansaryy’.
en.sarwar: 3. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Hammad ibn ‘Uthman from al-Halabiy who has said
the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘Abu Talhah al-Ansariy prepared Lahad for the Messenger of Allah.’”
